item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong independent evidence that Sisi broadly translated rhetorical commitments to equality into equal treatment in courts, schools, detention, or refugee administration in 2024. The positive evidence is mostly official or programmatic. The negative evidence is more concrete and operational, especially for political dissenters and refugees. So the best reading is that 2024 contained some equality-oriented policy language and targeted inclusion programs, but not a convincing, system-wide protection of dignity and equal opportunity.","evidence":[{"title":"Women’s Empowerment Strategy 2030","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-03-12","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/strategies/womens-empowerment-strategy-2030/","summary":"The presidency assigned the strategy to the government and state agencies as a working document. The text explicitly frames equal opportunity, women’s rights, labor participation, legal protection, and social integration as state priorities. Positive on paper, but it is still official self-presentation rather than proof of lived equality.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.4","6B.2"]},{"title":"Minister: Labor ministry has strategy to empower women","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-03-23","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/minister-labor-ministry-has-strategy-to-empower-women/","summary":"The labor ministry said it had a strategy to empower women economically and socially, with training programs, job opportunities, and a gender-equality unit created at Sisi’s direction. This supports a limited equal-opportunity claim, though it remains administrative and official.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.4","6B.2"]},{"title":"World Bank Group Statement of Support to Egypt’s Development and Reform Efforts","publisher":"World Bank Group","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/statement/2024/03/18/world-bank-group-statement-of-support-to-egypt-s-development-and-reform-efforts","summary":"The 2024 reform agenda was framed around inclusive growth, human capital, resilience, and protection of the poorest and most vulnerable. This is the best broad external framing I found for a dignity-plus-opportunity approach, but it still says more about policy intent than equal treatment in daily life.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"House of Representatives approves drafted Social Solidarity bill","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-12-01","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/house-of-representatives-approves-drafted-social-solidarity-bill/","summary":"The bill aimed to unify support programs and empower the most needy, with formal eligibility rules rather than ad hoc distribution. That is a modest positive for equal treatment and reduced arbitrariness, though it is official self-description.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"Launch of the Joint UN Programme under the Joint Platform for Migrants and Refugees in Egypt","publisher":"UNHCR Egypt","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.unhcr.org/eg/news/launch-joint-un-programme-under-joint-platform-migrants-and-refugees-egypt","summary":"Egypt, the UN, and the EU launched a program to support health and education for refugees and migrants in vulnerable situations. This is a real inclusion signal for displaced people, but it is narrow and heavily externally supported.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Egypt: Civic Space Under Siege","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/egypt-civic-space-under-siege","summary":"HRW said authorities drastically curtailed free expression and peaceful assembly before the presidential vote to stymie meaningful competition. That directly cuts against equal political opportunity and dignified participation in public life.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt: Opposition Leader Imprisoned","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-06-04","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/04/egypt-opposition-leader-imprisoned","summary":"HRW said Ahmed Tantawy and supporters were imprisoned and barred from elections for peaceful political activism. This is direct evidence against equal political opportunity, because contesting the ruler brought punishment.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt: Release protesters and activists detained over Palestine solidarity","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-14","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/egypt-release-protesters-and-activists-detained-over-palestine-solidarity/","summary":"Amnesty documented arrests of human-rights defenders, journalists, and lawyers over peaceful solidarity actions, and said complaints of sexual violence in custody were not properly investigated. This is strong negative evidence on dignity and equal civic standing.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.5","6B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt: More than 100 arbitrarily detained over calls for anti-government protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-07-18","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/","summary":"Amnesty said people were arrested for complaining about price hikes and power cuts, including women and a child, with incommunicado detention and broad security charges. That shows hardship complaints were met with coercion, not equal dignity.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.6","6B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt: Education Restricted for Refugees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/egypt-education-restricted-for-refugees","summary":"HRW found tens of thousands of refugee and asylum-seeking children out of school because of residency requirements, fees, and discrimination. This is direct evidence that equal opportunity was not being delivered for a vulnerable population.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"Egypt: President al-Sisi must reject new asylum law which violates refugee rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-03","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/egypt-president-al-sisi-must-reject-new-asylum-law-which-violates-refugee-rights/","summary":"Amnesty said the asylum law restricted movement, lacked due process, and failed to protect education, housing, and social security rights. That is strong contrary evidence on dignity, equal opportunity, and rights-respecting administration.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]}]}
